title: The Twisted Handshake
story: In the dimly lit alley behind the old Theater of Shadows, a gruesome find shattered the quiet night. Detective John discovered the body of acclaimed actor, Emile de Ravin, lying in a pool of blood. The distraught theater manager, Ms. Lydia Ross, stated she last saw Emile entering the theater after a late-night rehearsal.
crimeScene: Dark alley behind Theater of Shadows
forensicClue: The murderer wore a distinctive left-handed glove, leaving a unique DNA profile.
question: Who killed Emile de Ravin and why?
options: Option A (Suspect 1 and reason): The bitter rival, theater critic, Mr. Thomas Blackwood, had years of enmity towards Emile over their on-stage conflict.
Option B (Suspect 2 and reason): The desperate costume designer, Ms. Ava Wilson, who recently lost her job to Emile, sought revenge.
Option C (Suspect 3 and reason): The enigmatic and jealous set designer, Mr. Isaac Fox, had a motive due to Emile stealing his award-winning set design.
Option D (Suspect 4 and reason): The mysterious and long-time friend, Ms. Maya Patel, who had a secret motive related to the theater production.
deductionExplanation: Through interviews, Detective John discovered that all suspects had valid reasons to commit the crime. However, the distinctive left-handed DNA found at the scene could only belong to Ms. Maya Patel, who wore gloves during their last meeting discussing theater secrets the night before the murder.
